title: Microsoft Teams: private chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings (GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing describes Teams chat retention and eDiscovery storage as undocumented, although Microsoft publishes general rules covering Teams chats. It also omits the legal-hold exception to the town hall attendee-chat storage period and overstates the absence of government-cloud documentation. The roadmap details and Meeting chat policy path and command are supported.

claims.claim: Learn documents an event group chat among organisers, co-organisers and presenters in events optimised for large audiences such as town halls.
claims.quote:
In events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls, the chat experience differs depending on the event role.

Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat with each other in the event group chat.

claims.claim: The documented town hall event group chat is available before, during and after the event.
claims.quote: The event group chat is available before, during, and after an event

claims.claim: Learn describes the event group chat as separate from chat with attendees.
claims.quote: The event group chat is available before, during, and after an event, and is a separate experience from the chat with attendees.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the separate event group chat for webinars or structured meetings.
claims.quote: Searched: "event group chat" webinar structured meetings default policy PowerShell retention licensing government. Read Manage chat for Teams events and Manage chat in Microsoft Teams meetings; neither describes separate group chat for webinars or structured meetings.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the event group chat for US Government clouds.
claims.quote:
GCC Customers
1. Event group chat: Organizers, coorganizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.
claims.fix: Replace 'or for the US Government clouds' with 'or specifically for GCC High and DoD'. The Learn government-channel release notes describe event group chat for GCC, so do not claim absence across all US Government clouds.

claims.claim: The town hall attendee meeting-chat limitations say chat is unavailable on GCC, GCCH and DoD; this is not a statement excluding the separate event group chat.

claims.claim: No tenant or policy switch, admin UI setting or PowerShell parameter specific to event group chat is documented.

claims.claim: Town hall attendee chat is stored in the organiser's mailbox for up to 30 days.
claims.quote: Meeting chat messages in events optimized for large audiences, excluding the event group chat, are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days. ... However, if you place the organizer’s mailbox on legal hold, the mailbox keeps the chat messages for longer.
claims.fix: Add the qualification 'unless the organiser's mailbox is on legal hold, in which case the mailbox keeps the messages for longer' to the 30-day statement. Keep the explicit exclusion of event group chat.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The event-chat page explicitly excludes event group chat from its organiser-mailbox and 30-day storage statement.
claims.quote: Meeting chat messages in events optimized for large audiences, excluding the event group chat, are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented where event group chat messages are stored for retention and eDiscovery.
claims.quote: Data from Teams chats is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of each user included in the chat ... These hidden folders ... store data that compliance administrators can search with eDiscovery tools.
claims.fix: Replace the broad absence throughout with: 'Microsoft documents that Teams chat compliance copies are stored in hidden folders in participants' mailboxes and can be searched with eDiscovery tools. The event-chat page excludes event group chat from the separate town hall attendee-chat storage rule.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-teams. Remove the open question asking whether Teams chat retention and eDiscovery are documented; retain a narrower request to validate the planned GCC High and DoD experience in the tenant.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Scope
claims.claim: Meeting chat is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select the policy you want to edit.
3. Go to the Meeting engagement section.
4. Set Meeting chat to your chosen value

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled turns off meeting chat for users assigned the policy.
claims.quote:
To turn off meeting chat for users with this assigned policy, run the following command:

Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled
